title: Essential vectors and rank: a machine-checked Lean 4 proof
description: A machine-checked Lean 4 proof that in a finite family of nonzero vectors over a field with a redundancy, the number of essential vectors (those not in the span of the rest; the coloops of the represented matroid) plus one is at most the rank of the family. Checked against Lean v4.36.0 with Mathlib; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Includes a typeset note (paper.tex, PDF).
